meaning:
1) desire, incline, covet, wait longingly, wish, sigh, want, be greedy, prefer
1a) (Piel) to desire, crave (food and drink)
1b) (Hithpael) to desire, long for, lust after (of bodily appetites)
glosses: had a strong craving for other food

renderings.bsb: had a strong craving for other food

elsewhere.note: The mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly; and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, “Who will give us meat to eat?
“You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. Neither shall you desire your neighbor’s house, his field, or his male servant, or his female servant, his ox, or…
If the man said to him, “Let the fat be burned first, and then take as much as your soul desires;” then he would say, “No, but you shall give it to me now; and…
Abner said to David, “I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel to my lord the king, that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may reign over…
I will take you, and you shall reign according to all that your soul desires, and shall be king over Israel.
David longed, and said, “Oh that one would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”
But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.
So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.
